_note: 科研時事（站點級，跨科目）。顯示在三科總覽頁。cat 用 bio/chem/phys/math，只影響標籤顏色。越新的排越前。內容必須來自可靠來源並附連結——時事不是常識，寧可少寫也不要編。每天從泛科學、ScienceDaily、Nature 主刊精選 8 篇（單一來源最多 3 篇、單一科目最多 3 篇），本檔由 scripts/fetch_news.py 自動產生，可手動補充。

items.t: 哈佛大學的微型紫外線晶片可以幫助縮小量子電腦的尺寸
items.x: 哈佛大學領導的研究人員開發了一種微型裝置，透過有效地將紅光轉換為紫外線，產生的紫外線比以前的同類方法多 120 倍。這項突破可以解鎖更小的量子電腦、超精密原子鐘和緊湊的環境感測器。
items.orig: Harvard’s tiny UV light chip could help shrink quantum computers
items.origX: Harvard-led researchers have developed a microscopic device that generates 120 times more ultraviolet light than previous comparable approaches by efficiently converting red light into UV. The breakthrough could unlock smaller quantum computers, ultra-precise atomic clocks, and compact environmental sensors.

items.t: 大腦區域在言語中的神秘作用終於被破解
items.x: 韋尼克區以處理口語單字而聞名，但大腦記錄顯示，它也對相關的認知任務做出了至關重要的貢獻。
items.orig: Brain area’s mysterious role in speech decoded at last
items.origX: Wernicke’s area is known for processing spoken words, but brain recordings reveal that it also makes a crucial contribution to a related cognitive task.

items.t: 終於在南極冰層下發現了蹤跡！諾貝爾物理學獎頒給了他？【慢科學EP14】
items.x: 2017年9月，南極冰層下的「冰立方微中子天文台」在43秒內發出警報，引爆全球望遠鏡追查宇宙高能微中子的源頭。從鑽穿兩千公尺深冰的艱鉅工程，到開啟多信使天文學並獲得諾貝爾物理學獎肯定，帶你走完這段跨越六十年的追光之旅。

items.t: 為什麼氫火焰會發出橙色光，然後幾乎看不見
items.x: 氫火焰可以從亮橙色轉變為幾乎看不見，這取決於一些意想不到的情況：空氣中漂浮著微量的鈉。科學家表示，這項發現可以透過用專門的感測器取代視覺火焰檢測來幫助未來的氫動力爐和烤箱更安全。
items.orig: Why hydrogen flames can glow orange, then turn nearly invisible
items.origX: Hydrogen flames can shift from bright orange to nearly invisible depending on something unexpected: tiny amounts of sodium floating in the air. Scientists say this discovery could help make future hydrogen-powered stoves and ovens safer by replacing visual flame detection with specialized sensors.

items.t: 植物萃取的救命抗癌藥物
items.x: 在一項概念驗證研究中，科學家誘導一種與菸草相關的植物合成化療藥物紫杉醇。
items.orig: Life-saving cancer drug pumped out by a plant
items.origX: In a proof-of-concept study, scientists have coaxed a tobacco-related plant to synthesize the chemotherapy drug paclitaxel.

items.t: 這樣炸薯條超級好吃？科學家登上細胞內的小星球【泛科學NEWS EP73】
items.x: 想吃外酥內軟又低油的薯條，加點微波就行？科學家打造微波油炸機破解吸油關鍵！本期科學新聞還帶你登上細胞內的溶小體，看臺灣團隊如何找到控制離子通道的「醣分子煞車」；並揭曉臺灣法律 AI 評測、遊蕩犬對原生食肉動物的影響，以及長期缺錢與大腦老化的關聯。

items.t: 一種簡單的金屬隱藏著一種奇怪的新形式的磁性
items.x: 科學家在一種看似普通的金屬中發現了一種奇怪的磁性，這種金屬沒有整體磁化，但卻深刻地改變了電子的行為。這項突破為理解奇異量子材料和開發未來電子技術提供了一條有前途的新途徑。
items.orig: A simple metal is hiding a strange new form of magnetism
items.origX: Scientists have discovered a strange form of magnetism in an ordinary-looking metal that has no overall magnetization yet profoundly changes how electrons behave. The breakthrough offers a promising new path toward understanding exotic quantum materials and developing future electronic technologies.

items.t: 用於全鈣鈦礦串聯太陽能電池的原位氧化還原轉換分子
items.x: 全鈣鈦礦串聯太陽能電池 (TSC) 因其超越單結鈣鈦礦太陽能電池 (PSC) 效率極限的能力而受到關注1,2。然而，全鈣鈦礦TSC的效率和穩定性受到錫鉛（Sn-Pb）窄帶隙子電池中電洞傳輸層/鈣鈦礦界面化學不穩定性的限制，這會引入深陷阱態
items.orig: An in situ redox-converted molecule for all-perovskite tandem solar cells
items.origX: All-perovskite tandem solar cells (TSCs) are gaining prominence due to their ability to surpass the efficiency limit of single-junction perovskite solar cells (PSCs)1,2. However, the efficiency and stability of all-perovskite TSCs are limited by chemical instability at the hole transport layer/perovskite interface in the tin-lead (Sn-Pb) narrow-bandgap subcell, which introduces deep trap states from tin cations and promotes non-radiative recombination3-5. Here we incorporate a redox-converted molecule of p-aminobenzohydrazide (ABH) into poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):polystyrene sulfonate (PEDOT:PSS) that neutralizes PSS acidity, heals Sn4+ defects, and generates a dipole passivation effect upon oxidation. During the preparation of Sn-Pb perovskites, ABH suppresses interfacial oxidation by reducing Sn4+ defects and converts to p-aminobenzaldehyde (ABD), which suppresses photogenerated hole-induced Sn2+ oxidation, aligning energy levels for efficient hole extraction. The in situ redox-converted molecule stabilizes the buried interface during both device fabrication and operation, reduces non-radiative recombination and enhances stability. The resulting narrow-bandgap Sn-Pb PSC achieves a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.4% (certified 25.2%) with an open-circuit voltage of 0.92 V and a fill factor of 83.4%. Integrated into monolithic all-perovskite TSCs, the device delivers a PCE of 31.1% (certified 30.8%) together with enhanced thermal (ISOS-D-2I, 85 °C) and operational stability (ISOS-L-1I) under inert conditions.
